name: Thermodynamic Conservation Disguise
description: Replaces the standard "connect the hubs/terminals" graph connectivity requirement with a thermodynamic energy redistribution constraint. Requires models to logically deduce that achieving any zero-sum energy redistribution among a subset of nodes with zero net-change on intermediate nodes is mathematically identical to ensuring all nodes in the subset belong to the same connected component. This breaks surface-level pattern matching on graph terminology.
